title: genista cinerea subsp. valentina
intro: Genista cinerea subsp. valentina, commonly known as Spiny broom or Genista valentina, is a plant species belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). It is a shrub native to the Mediterranean region, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Genista cinerea subsp. valentina include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
